cat > /tmp/recover.py <<'EOF'
import struct, json
data = open('/app/trunc.db','rb').read()

def varint(b, off):
    v=0
    for i in range(9):
        c=b[off+i]
        if i==8:
            return (v<<8)|c, off+9
        v=(v<<7)|(c&0x7f)
        if not (c&0x80):
            return v, off+i+1

def parse_record(b, off):
    hlen, o = varint(b, off)
    hend = off+hlen
    types=[]
    while o < hend:
        st, o = varint(b, o)
        types.append(st)
    body=hend
    vals=[]
    for st in types:
        if st==0: vals.append(None)
        elif 1<=st<=6:
            n=[0,1,2,3,4,6,8][st]
            vals.append(int.from_bytes(b[body:body+n],'big',signed=True)); body+=n
        elif st==7:
            vals.append(struct.unpack('>d',b[body:body+8])[0]); body+=8
        elif st==8: vals.append(0)
        elif st==9: vals.append(1)
        elif st>=12 and st%2==0:
            n=(st-12)//2; vals.append(b[body:body+n]); body+=n
        elif st>=13 and st%2==1:
            n=(st-13)//2; vals.append(b[body:body+n].decode('utf-8','replace')); body+=n
    return vals

ncell = struct.unpack('>H', data[3:5])[0]
ptrs = [struct.unpack('>H', data[8+2*i:10+2*i])[0] for i in range(ncell)]
rows=[]
for ptr in ptrs:
    plen,o = varint(data,ptr)
    rowid,o = varint(data,o)
    vals = parse_record(data,o)
    # choose word/value as last two fields (first field is NULL)
    word = next(v for v in vals if isinstance(v,str))
    value = next(v for v in vals if isinstance(v,(int,float)))
    rows.append({"word":word,"value":value})
rows.sort(key=lambda r:r["word"])
open('/app/recover.json','w').write(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(rows))
EOF
